en.headline: Police arrest four boys over Sai Wan Ho alley assault video
en.dek: Eastern district officers detained four local boys aged 13 to 17 on suspicion of assault occasioning actual bodily harm and inciting others to join an illegal society.
body: Police have arrested four boys aged 13 to 17 after a video circulated online showing a child being pushed and slapped in a Sai Wan Ho alley.

Officers said they noticed the footage, which appeared to show an incident around 3 a.m. on 19 October. The Eastern police district launched an investigation and arrested the four local boys on 20 October.

They are suspected of assault occasioning actual bodily harm and of inciting others to become members of an illegal society. All are being detained. The Eastern police district anti-triad unit is following up.
In the video, one person is heard saying “I’m your boss” before the group leaves.

zh.headline: 西灣河後巷毆人影片 警方拘捕四名13至17歲男童
zh.dek: 東區警區拘捕四名本地男童，涉嫌襲擊致造成身體傷害及煽惑他人成為非法社團成員。
body: 網上流傳一段西灣河後巷影片，顯示一名男童遭人推倒及掌搴，警方其後拘捕四名年齡介乎13至17歲的男童。
警方表示留意到有關影片，顯示事件大約於10月19日凌晨3時發生。東區警區展開調查，並於20日拘捕四名本地男童。
被捕人涉嫌「襲擊致造成身體傷害」及「煽惑他人成為非法社團成員」，現正被扣留調查。案件由東區警區反三合會行動組跟進。
影片中有人喝罵「我先係你大佬」。
